description: Rule chains (L2 and L3 to a fixed point). A constraint that applies to a shown block depends on a block in another section, a constraint on that block depends on the next, four rounds deep: every rule and every block of the chain is carried, a dependency brings the section constraint of its own section (CSTORE), and a task's :depends edge is followed too. Which 50 blocks a limit lets through the laws do not say, so they count as context, not as required. A chain past 5 hops is cut with depth, and a rule chain past 50 blocks is cut with limit; both make the view incomplete, with coverage false.
